title: coleus socotranus
intro: Coleus socotranus, commonly known as the Socotran Coleus, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving stress, and promoting relaxation. The health benefits of Coleus socotranus include antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as pain relief and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Coleus socotranus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
